description: Representative Kirk Haskins raised concerns about selective enforcement after House Elections Committee Chair Pat Proctor called for an investigation into $5 gift cards offered to students registering to vote at two Kansas high schools. According to reporting from Kansas Reflector, Haskins also pointed out that Proctor used state-produced letterhead when posting about the matter on his campaign Facebook page, potentially raising a separate campaign law issue.
